::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What the symbols mean

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $A$ | **Area** (square units) |
| $b$ | **Base**: any side of the triangle you choose |
| $h$ | **Height**: the distance from the base to the opposite corner, measured **at a right angle** to the base |
| $s$ | A slanted side. It is the height only if it meets the base at a right angle |
:::
